summary.business_type: Financial Utility / Programmatic Web Application (US 50 States, Canada, VAT)
summary.current_status: Traffic dropped 75% between Aug 31 and Sep 5 (1,800 impr/day -> 450 impr/day) due to Google algorithmic Helpful Content / Scaled Content filter on 49 templated state pages.
summary.rank_position_reality: Core keyword 'reverse sales tax calculator' dropped from Position 4.6 (top 5) to Position 45.8. Site is currently on Page 5 for primary head term, but technically sound and poised for #1 recovery.
top_findings: Algorithmic Scaled Content devaluation: 49 state pages contain ~910 words of identical boilerplate ('Decoding Business Receipts in [State]...').
Core keyword dropped from Position 4.6 to 45.8 around Sept 1-5 corresponding with Google Search Generative AI rollout and spam policy updates.
Internal cannibalization between Homepage (/), /how-it-works (391 words thin), and /faq (2,576 words) splitting ranking equity.
Brand & Entity Identity mismatch: Domain is salestaxreversecalculator.com, but UI/Schema brand is 'PreTaxPrice', confusing Google Knowledge Graph.
Zero external backlink authority (DA ~ 0, not yet cataloged in Common Crawl), while competitors have 100+ referring domains.
quick_wins: Consolidate /how-it-works and /faq into the Homepage via 301 redirects to eliminate cannibalization and funnel 100% equity to the #1 ranking target.
Add HowTo schema (Step 1: Enter total, Step 2: Input tax rate, Step 3: Compute original price) to win rich snippets.
Align brand signals: Unify 'Reverse Sales Tax Calculator' and 'PreTaxPrice' in meta title, OpenGraph, and Organization schema.
Fix New York H1 tag from 'New York Sales Tax Calculator' to 'New York Reverse Sales Tax Calculator'.
Compress homepage formula diagram from 630 KB to WebP (~60 KB) and add state rate visual graphics to top 10 states.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 100% crawlable raw HTML (7,673 words SSR without client JS requirement)
Valid XML sitemap with 81 URLs submitting cleanly in Google Search Console
Strict HSTS (preload, max-age 63072000), nosniff, and SAMEORIGIN security headers
Edge TTFB of 46ms via Vercel globally distributed CDN
Perfect 100/100 Lighthouse Best Practices and SEO scores

findings.title: Sitemap & Canonical Trailing Slash Inconsistency
findings.description: sitemap.xml lists URLs without trailing slashes (e.g. https://salestaxreversecalculator.com), whereas the server canonical URL matches with slash.
findings.recommendation: Standardize all URLs in sitemap.xml to match the exact canonical URLs.

findings.title: 2-Hop Redirect Chain on HTTP WWW Subdomain
findings.description: http://www.salestaxreversecalculator.com redirects to https://www. (308) then to https://root (301).
findings.recommendation: Add a single edge routing rule in next.config.js or Vercel config to redirect directly to https://salestaxreversecalculator.com/.

categories.name: Content Quality & Scaled Content
what_works: Homepage contains 6,687 words of thorough educational, formulaic, and practical tax guidance
New York state page has been upgraded to 2,408 words with deep NYC local tax nuances
Clear step-by-step mathematical proofs and receipt decoding instructions

findings.title: Scaled Content Boilerplate Across 49 State Pages (Primary Drop Cause)
findings.description: 49 out of 50 state pages have ~910 words that follow a word-for-word template where only the state name is substituted. This programmatic footprint caused Google to apply a domain-level quality suppression in early September 2026.
findings.recommendation: Follow the NYC rewrite blueprint across the top 10 highest-traffic states (CA, TX, FL, PA, IL, OH, GA, NC, MI, NJ), adding state-specific nexus rules, local county ranges, and unique receipt examples.

findings.title: Keyword Cannibalization Across /, /how-it-works, and /faq
findings.description: GSC reveals Google cycling rankings between /, /how-it-works, /faq, and /tax-rates for core queries like 'back out tax calculator'. /how-it-works is thin content (391 words).
findings.recommendation: 301 redirect /how-it-works to /#how-it-works on the homepage, and canonicalize or 301 redirect /faq to /#faq.

findings.title: Branding & Entity Dilution (PreTaxPrice vs Reverse Sales Tax Calculator)
findings.description: The domain is salestaxreversecalculator.com, but the UI header and Organization schema declare 'PreTaxPrice'. This fragments entity authority.
findings.recommendation: Unify the brand identity: 'Reverse Sales Tax Calculator by PreTaxPrice' in schema, OpenGraph, and footer.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: H1 spacing bug successfully resolved on homepage and state pages
Title tags concise and within the 60-character budget
Primary calculator tool is visible immediately in the initial viewport

findings.title: New York H1 Intent Mismatch
findings.description: The New York page H1 is 'New York Sales Tax Calculator' rather than 'New York Reverse Sales Tax Calculator', dropping the core reverse intent keyword.
findings.recommendation: Update H1 to 'New York Reverse Sales Tax Calculator (NYC 8.875%)'.

findings.title: Broken Encoding Character in Privacy Policy Meta Description
findings.description: The Privacy Policy meta description has an unescaped replacement character: 'We collect no personal data  all calculations...'.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a standard ASCII hyphen or clean UTF-8 em-dash.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: Multi-schema graph with WebApplication (FinanceApplication), WebSite, Organization, FAQPage, and ImageObject
Fully valid JSON-LD parsing with zero syntax errors
Zero-dollar Offer schema accurately signaling free financial utility

findings.title: Missing HowTo Structured Data
findings.description: Competitors like reversesalestaxcalc.org utilize HowTo schema for the reverse calculation steps to capture Google step-by-step rich snippets.
findings.recommendation: Add a HowTo schema block detailing the 3-step calculation process.

findings.title: Missing Financial Specialist / CPA Reviewer Entity (E-E-A-T)
findings.description: Financial calculation pages fall under Google's YMYL (Your Money Your Life) guidelines. No Person / ReviewedBy schema exists.
findings.recommendation: Add an author / reviewedBy schema linking to a verified financial editor or tax professional profile.
